authoritativeDeclarationSet.roleSourceRule: Every --oluk-* declaration in the hash-locked source file is the complete light role set. Consumers must preserve its value graph and may not alias a role to Majestic.

requiredSemanticSeparations.evidence: Evidence has its own primitive and state contract; it is not a colour alias of stock or success.
requiredSemanticSeparations.rule: Stock uses cobalt/cobalt-soft. Green success is non-inventory only.

themePolicy.dark: deferred pending a role-for-role Sites review; no Shopper prototype value is imported by this manifest

consumerGuards: No --oluk-* value may reference a --majestic-* value.
No consumer may rename the stock roles as success roles.
A local token extension requires an explicit handoff-baseline amendment.
